name: Bodrogkisfalud (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue triangles along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bodrogkisfalud (a blue shield with a yellow cross and a bunch of grapes, within a green wreath) above a yellow scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bodrogkisfalud arms with wreath and scroll
